# {officer.pptx}

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/markheckmann/officer.pptx/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/markheckmann/officer.pptx/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/markheckmann/officer.pptx/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/markheckmann/officer.pptx?branch=main)
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of `officer.pptx` is to extent pptx related features from the `officer` package and is complelety compatible with it.


## Installation

You can install the development version of `officer.pptx` from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("markheckmann/officer.pptx")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(officer.pptx)
## basic example code
```
